purpose: Teach: 宮内/市況/愛さ/べし/つた/こく/まぜ/混ざっ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お味の濃くなった煮物、お客様に伝った、絶対お気に入りです。蓮、宮内関連の文献も読め
lines.en: You need to read the literature on the Imperial court connections, Ren. Your customers will notice if your research depth shows.
lines.style: Steady, measured. Speaks as someone accustomed to being listened to. Each sentence lands with quiet weight. No rush. The tone of a mentor who expects the mentee to catch the implication.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。市況をふまえた研究計画を立てます
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll develop a research plan grounded in current market conditions.
lines.style: Respectful but not stiff. Quick acknowledgment on 'yes,' then careful, deliberate pace through the plan. Shows he's already thinking it through. Slightly formal register — appropriate deference without distance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究を愛さない者は伸びない
lines.en: Ren — researchers who don't love their work don't grow.
lines.style: Direct, not unkind. Speaks it like a fact, not a reproach. Slight emphasis on 'love' — not romantic, but genuine care for the subject. Pause before his name, as if calling him to attention.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究者たる者、誠実であるべしと心得ます
lines.en: Yes, sir. I understand that a researcher must conduct themselves with sincerity.
lines.style: Formal, deliberate. He's translating the guidance into his own commitment. Slight solemnity — he takes this seriously. Clean delivery, no hesitation, but not rushed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、文献を辿る勘も身につけるべし
lines.en: And you'll develop an intuition for tracing through the literature, Ren. That can't be taught — only cultivated.
lines.style: Slower here. Thoughtful. The pause before 'only cultivated' gives weight to what's about to follow. Speaks like someone who has watched this skill develop in good researchers over decades.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。指導教官のお考えを継ぐべく励みます
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll work to inherit your approach and build on it.
lines.style: Quiet determination. 'Inherit' lands with respect — he knows what's being offered. Steady pace, but there's an undercurrent of commitment. Not performing reverence, but genuine.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、異分野の手法をまぜて新発見を狙え
lines.en: Try mixing methods from different fields, Ren. That's where new discoveries live.
lines.style: Energized slightly — this is advice he believes in. 'Try' is an invitation, not a command. Lean forward in the voice. Conviction that borders on urgency, but still measured by his nature.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。多分野の理論が混ざった論文を執筆中です
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'm actually writing a paper right now that draws from multiple theoretical frameworks.
lines.style: Pleased but understated. Quick lift on 'actually' — he's already doing this. The closing quiets slightly, trailing off with quiet confidence. Shows initiative without boasting.
